primary_question: On a new bolt-mounted campaign, how does a four-class logistic model fitted with previous bolt normal/load labels compare with the frozen model fitted with Monster Gel normal/load labels?

bolt_fit.selection: All previously audited exact-dose positive captures and their paired normal controls only. The 17+13 unpaired normal cycles stay unused, never a holdout.

calibration.selection: Original frozen V4 validation IDs, identical to original OLD_TO_BOLT logistic calibration
calibration.rule: q95 using higher, strict score > threshold

preprocessing: V4 exact ordered 24 features, median imputer and StandardScaler refit on bolt fit rows only
scoring: Frozen V4 PCA-Q or 1-P(normal); logistic type is highest abnormal class score after an alarm
future_missing_feature_policy: Only missing ID1_3_5s_IQR in a quality-reviewed valid cycle may use each frozen imputer. Any Inf or other missing required feature requires review before scoring.
evaluation_policy: Collect a new complete campaign after this freeze. Use identical admitted cycles for all models. New captures are evaluation only, no data-driven threshold/model changes. Count normal FPR overall and by capture/pair, TPR by load, per-load paired AUROC/AP, type confusion for both logistic candidates. Report paired gains and losses and do not promote on tradeoffs alone.
